purpose: Avoid weakening an already useful PPO action while keeping the original 40 percent target blend when the action points elsewhere

fixed_rule.target: nearest currently visible target, chosen with the same distance and index tie rule as D
fixed_rule.keep_original_when: action Euclidean norm >= 0.50 AND cosine(action, target offset) >= 0.90
fixed_rule.otherwise: apply the unchanged D target blend fraction 0.40
fixed_rule.zero_or_low_magnitude_action: apply the unchanged D target blend
fixed_rule.numeric_type: float64 gate calculation; preserve original float32 action when gated; D function supplies float32 otherwise

diagnostic_first: Replay E016 v2b-02 with original, D target, and new conditional rule; compare step-5 action, target distance and full episode coverage. The single known case is diagnostic, not a selection criterion by itself.
primary_comparison: For each fixed E014-E016 model, compare new conditional target rule with its unchanged D target-only run on exactly the same v2 and v3 episodes; each suite contains 50 distinct basic and 50 distinct cooperation scenes with two repeats per scene.

continuation_rule.score: The equal-v2/v3, equal-three-model mean score improvement over D target-only must be at least +3.00
continuation_rule.replication: At least two of three models must improve their own equal-v2/v3 mean score by strictly more than 0
continuation_rule.group_coverage_limit: In each suite and group, the equal-three-model mean coverage drop may not exceed 0.005 absolute
continuation_rule.group_collision_limit: In each suite and group, the equal-three-model mean collision rise may not exceed 0.002 absolute
continuation_rule.if_pass: Only then evaluate one additional conditional-target-then-existing-avoidance combination on all three models and both development suites
continuation_rule.if_fail: Stop E3 without threshold tuning or combination evaluation; keep the existing E015 target/combo shortlist

final_confirmation_policy: Do not use A4 during E3; Windows local_preview is developmental, not official evaluation
